Pestinum.

Plaguinum. Nosode of Plague. Trituration of the virus.

Clinical.─Bubo. Plague. Typhus.

Characteristics.─The prophylaxis and treatment of plague with injections of more or less modified virus of plague by old-school practioners affords evidence that the nosode of plague is available, like other nosodes, for the treatment of cases of the disease from which it is derived.
